payload.reason: M2.4 Slice 1 is approved. The reported implementation is within the authorized two-file whitelist, preserves the User.php safety boundary, registers exactly the six required Seminar endpoints, reuses the existing Seminar models, CourseFile, AcademicMark, and AttainmentService without introducing duplicate persistence or grading infrastructure, and reports passing syntax, route registration, and full regression verification (37 tests, 291 assertions, 0 failures). The six-endpoint scope matches the analyzed M2.4 backend contract, including authentication, JSON negotiation, statutory rubric bounds, multi-assessor averaging, SBTE attendance slabs, 75-mark grading, AcademicMark persistence, print data preparation, and attainment calculation. The 549-line controller is acceptable for this backend slice; the mandatory >500-line decomposition rule applies to monolithic legacy Blade views, and M2.4 contains no UI migration. UI shell/component directives therefore remain reserved for the subsequent presentation migration and must be enforced there, with no ad-hoc UI infrastructure introduced. Slice 2 is appropriately isolated as verification-only and should not alter production implementation unless a test exposes a concrete defect; any such defect must be reported for architectural review rather than silently expanding the whitelist.
